breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that `pimpleFoam` is only a fluid solver and cannot handle the solid mechanics part of the FSI problem on its own. It resolved this by specifying the use of an external coupling library, `solids4foam`, which is a standard approach in OpenFOAM to couple a fluid solver with a solid mechanics solver for FSI simulations. This correctly addresses the fundamental requirement of using two coupled solvers for this type of problem.
